opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Projects must be led by organisations based in the UK; individuals must have formal employment with a UK host institution; projects led by schools, colleges, undergraduates, PhD students, or non-UK organisations are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK, with grants up to £500,000 (special cases up to £750,000).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly racially minoritised communities, and partnership applications; applicants should be based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and aims to inform public debate and policy to build an inclusive society.
